stills.prompt: Macro close-up of the hub and spokes of the worn original's black iron five-spoke flywheel from @engine, filling the frame; a thin film of oil gleams on the polished hub and the aged-gold (#C6A94F) brass collar. Behind it, soft and out of focus, the dull solid bronze copy's flywheel, fused and still. No connecting rod or crank in frame. Low-key interior: near-black stone workshop with almost no ambient light. One cool bone-white (#F5F2EB) light rakes from high left; everything else falls into black. Photorealistic, natural film grain.
